skill.name: auth
skill.description: Authentication and access control guidance for Next.js 15 App Router applications using Supabase Auth. It covers server-side route protection, Server Action checks, admin roles, GitHub OAuth, email verification, and family-based tenant isolation.
skill.summary: Build server-side Supabase authentication and role checks for Next.js applications.
skill.author: BOM-98

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, TypeScript examples, placeholder URLs, schema diagrams, and defensive environment guidance. I found one semantic privacy risk: the references document collecting SSN and other sensitive personal data and placing SSN in auth user metadata. The author should revise the data handling guidance before marketplace publication.

remediation.issue: Sensitive personal data is documented as auth metadata.
remediation.suggestion: Remove SSN and similar high-risk identifiers from auth metadata. Store only necessary sensitive data in a protected server-side table with encryption, strict access controls, auditing, and retention rules.

remediation.issue: Registration guidance appears to request more personal data than authentication requires.
remediation.suggestion: Apply data minimization. Collect identity fields only when the product requirement is clear, and document why each sensitive field is needed.

content.value_statement: Authentication flows in Next.js and Supabase can become inconsistent across pages, actions, and tenants. This skill provides server-side patterns for route protection, roles, OAuth, and family-based data isolation.
actual_capabilities: Guides route protection for Server Components, layouts, and Server Actions.
Explains admin-only pages, admin Server Actions, and conditional admin UI.
Documents family-based tenant isolation with required family access checks.
Covers login, logout, registration, email verification, and GitHub OAuth flows.
Lists key auth files, required environment variables, and related database tables.
Provides security requirements for token validation and server-side helper usage.
limitations: Tailored to Next.js 15 App Router and Supabase Auth projects.
Provides guidance and examples, not a complete runnable authentication package.
Assumes family-based tenancy with admin and member roles.
Does not replace a production security review or secrets management process.

use_cases.title: Protect Application Routes
use_cases.description: Add consistent authentication checks to protected pages, layouts, and Server Actions.

use_cases.title: Review Authorization Boundaries
use_cases.description: Check that admin features and family-scoped data access use server-side enforcement.

use_cases.title: Plan Supabase Auth Migration
use_cases.description: Map login, signup, OAuth, email verification, and token refresh flows before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Protect a Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this auth skill to protect a new dashboard page in a Next.js 15 App Router project with Supabase Auth.

prompt_templates.title: Secure a Server Action
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this auth skill to add server-side authentication to a Server Action that updates user profile data.

prompt_templates.title: Add Admin Access Control
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this auth skill to design admin-only page and Server Action checks for a settings area.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Tenant Isolation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this auth skill to review whether family-scoped data operations enforce server-side tenant isolation.

output_examples.input: Protect a dashboard page from unauthenticated visitors.
output: Identifies the server-side helper to use in the page or layout.
Places the check before protected content is returned.
Explains the expected redirect behavior for unauthenticated users.

output_examples.input: Review a family data update flow.
output: Confirms that the operation validates the current user first.
Checks that the submitted family identifier matches the user profile.
Calls out missing tenant checks before data changes occur.
Lists the provider setup requirement in Supabase.
Describes the sign-in action and callback route responsibilities.
Notes where redirects should send authenticated users.

best_practices: Validate users on the server with Supabase token revalidation before protected work.
Enforce roles and tenant access in Server Actions, not only in the interface.
Keep authentication helpers server-only and avoid exposing sensitive logic to Client Components.
anti_patterns: Relying on client-side role checks for authorization decisions.
Using session data on the server without token revalidation.
Skipping family access checks when handling user-supplied family identifiers.

faq.question: What framework is this skill designed for?
faq.answer: It is designed for Next.js 15 App Router projects that use Supabase Auth.

faq.question: Does it include complete application code?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflows, examples, file references, and security guidance for an existing project.

faq.question: Can it help with Server Actions?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains where to add server-side authentication and authorization checks before protected work.

faq.question: Does it support role-based access control?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents admin and member roles with separate checks for pages and Server Actions.

faq.question: How does it handle multi-tenant data?
faq.answer: It uses family-based tenant isolation and requires server-side validation before family data access.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
